content:
ana (AE): Starting thread for Orbita POC - customer wants document QA + semantic search + short-form summarization. Need quick alignment on success criteria, integration pattern (websocket vs streaming HTTP), auth, quotas, and security questionnaire answers.

kai (SE): Hi all. Primary integration requests: websocket streaming for low-latency token delivery, embedding index for semantic search, and an extractive QA pipeline returning spans + confidence. Do they need offline batch indexing?

ana (AE): They want nightly batch index of new docs (~10k documents/day) + realtime incremental indexing for newly uploaded docs. Latency target for QA queries: p95 < 350ms.

lea (SRE): For hybrid batch + realtime we should plan for Dedicated with autoscale burst for indexing. Nightly batch can run on worker fleet; realtime queries pinned to hot nodes. Also ask about log retention & SIEM integration.

noah (PM): Proposed success criteria:
- Relevance: mean reciprocal rank (MRR@5) > 0.60 on their eval set
- Latency: query p95 < 350ms for QA, <150ms for embedding lookup
- Stability: zero consumer-facing errors during demo window (end user failures)
- Ops: indexer throughput >= 200 docs/sec for nightly job

kai (SE): Auth options: hosted scoped API keys are quickest. If they require enterprise isolation, we can support VPC + mTLS. KMS: yes for Private/Dedicated. For hosted POC we can disable data retention and opt-out of training usage.

liz (solutions): Security Qs they raised: SOC2 certified? data residency in eu-west? can we provide IP allowlist for webhooks? answers: SOC2 yes, we have EU regions and can pin dedicated infra, webhooks support CIDR restrictions (we log attempts). I'll pull exact verbiage into the questionnaire.

kai (SE): Token/throughput estimate request: expected concurrent users? average prompt size? embedding size?

ana (AE): Customer says ~40 concurrent agents, typical QA query 150 input tokens, responses ~80 tokens. Expect 30k embeddings/month during onboarding. Realtime queries ~20 RPS, peaks 60 RPS.

lea (SRE): Rate-limit suggestion for POC: issue test key with soft 100 RPS and hard 300 RPS across account, token quota 50k tokens/min. For embeddings, quota 5k embed/min. We'll monitor and adjust.

kai (SE): Retry semantics: client should retry on 5xx and network errors with exponential backoff + cap. For streamed websocket, recommend resumable delta protocol: include last-sequence-id on reconnect. We'll provide an example client flow.

kai (SE): Python streaming snippet (minimal):
```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
with client.chat.stream(model='redwood-1-chat', messages=msgs) as s:
    for update in s:
        print(update.get('delta') or update.get('text'), end='')
```

noah (PM): Eval plan: we need 400 labeled QA pairs from them + 200 query logs. We'll run A/B: their current system vs our candidate; compute MRR, answer-span F1, hallucination count. I will own data collection.

liz (solutions): Pricing/POC estimate request: can finance provide a 3-week estimate with hosted baseline and Dedicated uplift option? Include costs for embeddings storage and dedicated nodes.

billing-bot: draft-estimate created: sales/poc-orbita/estimate-1946002345 (internal link)

ana (AE): Timeline suggestion:
- Day 0: creds + smoke tests, provide test API key
- Day 1-3: embedding pipeline + batch indexing verified
- Day 4-8: streaming chat & QA integration, early demo end of day 8
- Day 9-14: eval runs + tuning, performance tuning (batching/kv-cache)
- Day 15-21: final demo, collect sign-off
They asked for early demo by EOD day 8.

lea (SRE): Action items:
- (kai) produce websocket resumable protocol spec + python/js snippets
- (lea) confirm Dedicated sizing recommendation for nightly indexing and realtime SLOs; verify EU region availability
- (liz) draft questionnaire answers for SOC2/data residency/webhook ACLs
- (billing-bot) publish 3-week hosted + Dedicated estimate
- (noah) collect 400 QA pairs and 200 logs from customer by day 3

kai (SE): Note on logging: we can turn off request body logging for POC on Dedicated or Private. Hosted supports redaction flags but some metadata kept for telemetry. We'll include exact field list in the questionnaire.

ana (AE): Scheduling: let's meet tomorrow 9am PT to confirm keys and the timeline. Added calendar invite.

kai (SE): +1

lea (SRE): +1

noah (PM): +1

liz (solutions): +1

ana (AE): Closing: I'll upload customer's security form and initial corpus link to the shared drive before the call. If anyone has prefilled answers, paste them there.
